directionsTurn: Turn over two cards. Two cards that belong together make a pair.
directionsMismatch: If they do not match they stay face up. Choose any card to turn them back.
noMatch: No match: {first} and {second}. Choose any card to turn them back.
empty: Add pairs to make a game.
incomplete: Pairs with an empty side are left out: {count}
editing: Play is paused while you edit. Every pair is shown face up.
